{
  "decision-export-rotation-counter-increments": "WITH increments AS (
  SELECT player_code, rotation_no, tick_no,
         touch_count - LAG(touch_count, 1, 0) OVER (
           PARTITION BY player_code COLLATE BINARY, rotation_no ORDER BY tick_no
         ) AS new_touches
  FROM touch_readings
)
SELECT 'player,rotation,tick,new_touches' || char(10) || group_concat(line, '') AS csv_body
FROM (
  SELECT player_code || ',' || rotation_no || ',' || tick_no || ',' || new_touches || char(10) AS line
  FROM increments
  ORDER BY player_code COLLATE BINARY, rotation_no, tick_no
);",
  "decision-export-trip-advance-clearing-csv": "WITH balances AS (
  SELECT a.trip_code,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.amount_cents), 0) - a.advance_cents AS balance
  FROM trip_account AS a
  LEFT JOIN trip_entry AS e ON e.trip_code = a.trip_code COLLATE BINARY
    AND e.entry_kind IN ('expense', 'return')
  WHERE a.phase = 'closed'
  GROUP BY a.trip_code COLLATE BINARY, a.advance_cents
)
SELECT 'trip_code,direction,amount_cents' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(line, ''), '') AS csv_body
FROM (
  SELECT '"' || replace(trip_code, '"', '""') || '",' ||
         CASE WHEN balance > 0 THEN 'PAY' ELSE 'COLLECT' END || ',' || abs(balance) || char(10) AS line
  FROM balances
  WHERE balance <> 0
  ORDER BY trip_code COLLATE BINARY
);",
  "decision-export-unfulfilled-partner-kit-orders": "WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT r.partner_label,
         max(0, r.kits_ordered - COALESCE(SUM(d.kits_sent), 0)) AS outstanding
  FROM kit_request AS r
  LEFT JOIN kit_dispatch AS d ON d.request_id = r.request_id
  GROUP BY r.request_id, r.partner_label COLLATE BINARY, r.kits_ordered
)
SELECT 'partner,kits' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(line, ''), '') AS csv_contents
FROM (
  SELECT '"' || replace(partner_label, '"', '""') || '",' || SUM(outstanding) || char(10) AS line
  FROM per_order
  GROUP BY partner_label COLLATE BINARY
  HAVING SUM(outstanding) > 0
  ORDER BY partner_label COLLATE BINARY
);",
  "decision-export-walkthrough-confirmed-sign-defects": "WITH defects AS (
  SELECT sign_code, round_code, obs_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sign_code COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY obs_id COLLATE BINARY) AS pos
  FROM sign_observations
  WHERE finding = 'defect'
), confirmed AS (
  SELECT a.sign_code, a.obs_id AS first_obs, min(b.obs_id COLLATE BINARY) AS second_obs
  FROM defects AS a
  JOIN defects AS b ON b.sign_code = a.sign_code COLLATE BINARY
    AND b.round_code <> a.round_code COLLATE BINARY
  WHERE a.pos = 1
  GROUP BY a.sign_code COLLATE BINARY, a.obs_id
)
SELECT 'sign_code,first_obs,second_obs' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(line, ''), '') AS csv_content
FROM (
  SELECT '"' || replace(sign_code, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(first_obs, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(second_obs, '"', '""') || '"' || char(10) AS line
  FROM confirmed
  ORDER BY sign_code COLLATE BINARY
);"
}

WITH defects AS (
  SELECT sign_code, round_code, obs_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sign_code COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY obs_id COLLATE BINARY) AS pos
  FROM sign_observations
  WHERE finding = 'defect'
), confirmed AS (
  SELECT a.sign_code, a.obs_id AS first_obs, min(b.obs_id COLLATE BINARY) AS second_obs
  FROM defects AS a
  JOIN defects AS b ON b.sign_code = a.sign_code COLLATE BINARY
    AND b.round_code <> a.round_code COLLATE BINARY
  WHERE a.pos = 1
  GROUP BY a.sign_code COLLATE BINARY, a.obs_id
)
SELECT 'sign_code,first_obs,second_obs' || char(10) || COALESCE(group_concat(line, ''), '') AS csv_content
FROM (
  SELECT '"' || replace(sign_code, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(first_obs, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(second_obs, '"', '""') || '"' || char(10) AS line
  FROM confirmed
  ORDER BY sign_code COLLATE BINARY
